Commentary.Commentary: We’re back for India’s chase!  The umpires take their positions as the Sri Lanka Under-19 fielders spread out across the ground. Ayush Mhatre and Vaibhav Suryavanshi stride out to open the innings for India Under-19, while Newton Ranjithkumar has the new ball in hand, ready to kick off proceedings for Sri Lanka Under-19. Here we go!
... THE RUN CHASE ...

On the other hand, India Under-19 showcased an impressive bowling performance, with Chetan Sharma leading the charge by claiming 3 wickets. They were ably supported by Ayush Mhatre and Kiran Chormale, who took two wickets each. India will be looking for a solid batting display now and make their way into the finals. Stay tuned for the exciting chase ahead!

Sharujan Shanmuganathan was dismissed in the 29th over, narrowly missing out on a well-deserved half-century. Unfortunately for Sri Lanka, his dismissal triggered a collapse, with wickets falling regularly thereafter. Lakvin Abeysinghe stood firm amidst the faltering batting lineup and managed to top-score with a gritty 69 runs but departed in the 44th over as Sri Lanka were finally bowled out for a below-par, yet fightable total of 173 runs.

Sri Lanka Under-19 were off to a rocky start and lost their first three wickets for just 8 runs within the opening four overs. The early dismissals of both openers, followed by Vimath Dinsara's quick departure, left the team in a precarious position. However, the fourth wicket partnership between Sharujan Shanmuganathan and Lakvin Abeysinghe proved pivotal, as they stabilised the innings with a commendable partnership of 93 runs.
